headline: Fresh Assaults Pierce Kuura Strand as Marban Hollow Contested
war_summary: Fresh fighting has burst across the northern reaches of Kuura Strand, where an abrupt Colonial surge claimed Martti amidst mounting casualties and rapid troop arrivals. Just south, Marban Hollow has become a roiling flashpoint, logging five strategic base turnovers in the span of two hours as Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall repeatedly traded hands between Warden and Colonial forces. Weathered Expanse continues to bleed profusely, enduring over thirteen hundred casualties and three fresh flag shifts centered on Spirit Watch in the same period. In Olavis Wake, stubborn engagements persist with three base transitions dividing the district, while activity in neighboring Pari Peak and The Gutter settled into sporadic skirmishing after earlier frenzies. At the same time, earlier tumult across Stlican Shelf has cooled to near silence, and the grueling slugfests in Stonecradle, Callahan's Passage, and Farranac Coast grind on with high casualty tallies but no recent alterations to territorial control.
